title: Non-cryptographic random bytes used as a token in javascript — review required
description: pseudoRandomBytes is documented as a deprecated alias of randomBytes that does not guarantee cryptographically strong output. When its result is used as a token, identifier, or key material, the value is predictable enough to undermine the secret. The rule flags the call; use of the value is a review decision.
remediation: Use crypto.randomBytes or crypto.randomUUID for tokens, and treat pseudoRandomBytes as forbidden in security-relevant code.
limitation: Lexical: matches pseudoRandomBytes calls; Math.random and other weak sources are covered by separate rules.
